long_biography.plain_text:
Pauline Martigny created Le Salon de Passy around a combination of hairdressing and beauty treatments, drawing on her own experiences of spas and travel. She chose a brown-and-beige setting with private treatment rooms. With advice from a chemist, she developed orchid-based recipes for the salon’s signature treatments, including a scalp treatment followed by hairdressing.

In 2022, the Paris company adopted the name Pauligny Consulting and broadened its remit beyond beauty services. The change added advice on interior arrangements, staff management and training for premium service. It also encompassed furniture design and commercialisation, cosmetics, perfumery and bath products.

The change added advice on interior arrangements, staff management and training for premium service. It also encompassed furniture design and commercialisation, cosmetics, perfumery and bath products.
